     return false;\n453\t    }\n454\t  }\n455\t  return true;\n456\t}\n457\t\n458\t/**\n459\t * Clear a bit in the bitmap (for E12 block hash failure).\n460\t */\n461\texport function ==============================================================================\n477\t// BLOCK POSITION TRACKING FOR WRITES\n478\t//  */\n505\t  get currentPosition(): number {\n506\t    return this._currentPosition;\n507\t  }\n508\t\n509\t  /**\n510\t   * Total number of blocks written so far.\n511\t   */\n512\t  get
